dimensionReasonCodes.meaning: The branch is directly supported by one or more resolvable evidence spans.
Every claim used by the branch is present in the frozen input closure.
The later branch was issued by the same policy-owning authority as the earlier branch.
The competing branches come from explicitly peer authorities with no ranking evidence.
The frozen evidence does not justify an authority ordering.
The branch establishes the effective baseline at the evaluated knowledge version.
A later effective branch explicitly replaces the compared branch.
The branch scope matches the evaluated applicability.
The branch applies only to a strict subset of the evaluated applicability.
The branch is usable only when its explicit conditions are retained.
The branch remains current because the explicit replacement excludes its subject matter.
A grounded relation explicitly replaces the earlier branch within a stated scope.
A grounded relation explicitly records incompatible branches.
Peer branches conflict and the frozen evidence contains no authorized resolution.
No authority permitted to decide the issue has issued an effective decision.
The input closure is insufficient to rank the branch without fabricated certainty.
